Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness

Arabic text: مِنْ مَـظْلُومٍ ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِيْ فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ
Translation: For an oppressed person who was wronged in my presence and I did not help him

Arabic text: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ أُسْدِيَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ
Translation: And for a kindness that was shown to me and I did not thank for it

Arabic text: وَمِنْ مُسِيءٍ اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ
Translation: And for a wrongdoer who apologized to me and I did not excuse him

Arabic text: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَةٍ سَأَلَنِيْ فَلَمْ أُوثِرْهُ
Translation: And for a needy person who asked me and I did not give him preference

Arabic text: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذِيْ حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِيْ لِمُؤْمِنٍ فَلَمْ أُوَفِّرْهُ
Translation: And for a right of a believer that was obligatory upon me and I did not fulfill it

Arabic text: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِنٍ ظَهَرَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ
Translation: And for a fault of a believer that became apparent to me and I did not conceal it

Arabic text: وَمِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ
Translation: And for every sin that presented itself to me and I did not abandon it
I apologize to You, O my God, for all of these
And for their like, with an apology of remorse

Arabic text: يَكُونُ وَاعِظًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ
Translation: That may serve as an admonition for similar situations that lie ahead of me
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِيْ عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّلَّاتِ
Translation: And make my remorse for the mistakes I have committed

Arabic text: وَعَزْمِيْ عَلَى تَرْكِ مَا يَعْرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
Translation: And my determination to abandon the sins that present themselves to me
A repentance that earns Your love for me
O You Who loves those who repent
